other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry or have continuous residence there for the past three years.
Applicant must possess the education qualification as required by the Training Unit/Institution.
benefits_summary: Stipend of ₹2,500 per month, along with accommodation and travelling allowance during the training period.
documents_required: Prescribed format of the application form
